name: About Us
heading: The REXBEBE Heritage & Atelier Story
shortDescription: Dedicated to the softest beginnings and timeless heirloom craftsmanship.
detailedDescription: Founded with a heartfelt promise to tender baby skin, REXBEBE crafts heirloom clothing from certified organic Mongolian cashmere, French flax linen, and GOTS-certified Aegean cotton. Every garment is carefully hand-finished to ensure zero rough seams, non-toxic vegetable dyes, and pure cloud-like comfort for your little explorer.
seoTitle: About REXBEBE | Handcrafted Luxury Organic Baby Clothing
seoDescription: Learn about REXBEBE story. We create heirloom cashmere, organic cotton and French linen babywear with gentle European craftsmanship.

name: Shipping & Delivery
heading: Complimentary Boutique Delivery & Care
shortDescription: Fast, secure doorstep delivery wrapped in tissue paper and luxury ribbon.
detailedDescription: We offer complimentary courier delivery across Sri Lanka on all orders over LKR 10,000. Island-wide orders are dispatched within 24–48 hours in our signature gift box. International express shipping is available worldwide with end-to-end parcel tracking.
seoDescription: Island-wide courier delivery and worldwide express shipping options for REXBEBE baby clothing and nursery gifts.

name: Returns & Exchanges
heading: 30-Day Hassle-Free Babywear Exchanges
shortDescription: Because baby sizes change fast, our exchange policy is smooth and friendly.
detailedDescription: We understand that babies grow quickly! We happily offer 30-day unworn exchanges on all standard items. Simply contact our concierge team and we will arrange a convenient courier pickup from your home.
seoDescription: Easy 30-day baby clothing exchanges and returns. Enjoy stress-free boutique shopping at REXBEBE.

name: Size Guide
heading: Find the Perfect Gentle Fit for Baby
shortDescription: Detailed age, weight, and height measurements for newborn through toddler sizes.
detailedDescription: Our clothing is tailored with generous room for cloth or disposable diapers. If your little one is in-between percentiles, we always recommend choosing one size up for lasting wear.
seoDescription: Comprehensive sizing chart for newborn, infant, and toddler baby garments. Height and weight guides.
